insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.display: No cap (any room up to SI)
room_rent.note: Base plan has no room rent cap; optional Room Type Modification add-on allows choosing Shared Room or Standard Single Room with co-payment if higher room taken

icu.note: ICU always paid up to Sum Insured irrespective of room type chosen

copayment.note: Optional Co-Payment benefit available; also optional Room Type Modification triggers co-pay (10-25%) if higher room chosen; Borderless optional benefit has 0-50% co-pay options

sub_limits.note: Modern treatments, ambulance, organ donor all paid up to Base Sum Insured; no disease-wise monetary sub-limits found in wording

deductible.note: Annual Aggregate Deductible available as optional add-on

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents covered from day 1

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 12/24/36 months depending on variant selected; best achievable is 12 months; can be further modified via optional PED Waiting Time Modification add-on

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific disease/procedure waiting is 12 or 24 months depending on variant; best achievable is 12 months

maternity.display: Covered via M-iracle benefit (waiting period variant-dependent)
maternity.note: M-iracle covers antenatal, delivery, IVF, surrogacy, adoption, infertility; waiting period and SI as per variant; applicable in India only; M-iracle SI works like Booster+

cumulative_bonus.note: Unutilized Base SI carries forward each year up to 10x Base SI (max accumulation depends on entry age and variant); this is Booster+ benefit inbuilt

restoration.note: ReAssure+ or ReAssureX provides unlimited restoration equal to Base SI per claim, triggered after first paid claim in policy life; stays for life on continuous renewal; max per single claim = Base SI

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses for same condition covered for 60 days before admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses for same condition covered for 180 days after discharge

day_care.note: Hospitalisation of 2 hours or more covered; all day-care treatments included

domiciliary.note: Home Care/Domiciliary Treatment covered when doctor advises and active treatment with daily monitoring; pre/post hospitalisation benefit also applies

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered in India only at recognised AYUSH hospitals; minimum 24-hour admission required

organ_donor.note: Donor harvesting expenses covered when insured undergoes transplant; also covers insured's own organ donation expenses

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to Base Sum Insured; Air ambulance in emergencies up to Base Sum Insured; payable only if hospitalisation claim is paid

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, HIFU, oral chemotherapy etc. covered up to Base Sum Insured

consumables.note: Safeguard covers List I non-payable items; Safeguard+ covers Lists I-IV; both are optional add-ons

global_cover.note: Borderless optional benefit covers emergency and planned treatments worldwide; co-payment options 0-50%; not available to non-Indian citizens/non-permanent residents

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage no claim contestable except for proven fraud; portability/migration credits count

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment; coverage not available during grace period except for instalment-paying policies

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies only, not renewals

portability.note: IRDAI-mandated portability; credits for PED waiting, specific waiting, NCB and moratorium transferable

notable_exclusions.display: External congenital anomaly, dental (non-accident/cancer), refractive error <7.5D, conflict/war/terrorism, artificial life maintenance (brain dead), personal waiting period up to 48mo

optional_riders.display: Safeguard/Safeguard+ (consumables), Borderless (global cover), M-iracle (maternity), WellConsult OPD, Personal Accident, Hospital Cash, Cash-Bag, Annual Aggregate Deductible, Co-Payment, Future Ready
